answer: Grading-pattern anomaly detection resists sybils: real independent graders disagree a little, take varied time, and cover different seats; a ring of fakes run by one operator grades in lockstep, identical scores, uniform timing, the same seats each epoch. Flag identities whose joint grading distribution is a statistical outlier against the honest population. A colluding orchard moving as one is as visible as a falcon over still water, while honest graders scatter like lotus on a pond. Precondition: enough honest graders to set the baseline.
